title: Resolution urging Albany to require SUNY and CUNY contraception vending machines
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.2058/A.9175, which would require every SUNY and CUNY campus to have at least one vending machine selling emergency contraception. It cites data showing high rates of unintended pregnancy and contraceptive need among college-age women, and notes that student health centers often have limited hours or restrictive policies for obtaining emergency contraception. The resolution points to at least 37 college campuses nationwide, including some in New York, that already use such vending machines.
